relationships.subject: rimonabant
relationships.evidence_quote: rimonabant pretreatment fully blocked terpene response in this assay, suggesting that terpenes induce tail flick anti-nociception via the CB1

relationships.subject: α-humulene
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro experiments showed that all terpenes activated the CB1R, while some activated other targets.

relationships.subject: α-humulene
relationships.evidence_quote: each of the terpenes tested also caused ERK phosphorylation in CB2-expressing cells

relationships.subject: geraniol
relationships.evidence_quote: Only Geraniol displayed any presence of potential allosteric interaction and suggested it may be a negative allosteric modulator (NAM)

key_findings: Cannabis terpenes alpha-humulene, geraniol, linalool and beta-pinene induce cannabinoid tetrad behaviors, partly via CB1 and partly via adenosine A2a.
Terpenes were additive with WIN55,212-2 and activated CB1 and CB2 signaling in vitro.
